sentences.en: Juha walked at night on the road.
He heard a sound behind him.
He was very afraid and began to run.
He jumped over the fence inside.
He saw an open hole in the ground.
He went into it and lay quietly.
He waited there a long time.
Two men passed beside the hole.
They saw a man lying inside.
They asked: who are you, sir?

sentences.ar: הם שאלו: ומה אתה עושה כאן?
sentences.en: They asked: and what are you doing here?
He said: I am dead, of course.
They asked: and why do you speak?

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: כי אתם שאלתם אותי.
sentences.en: He said: because you asked me.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: מת גם עונה לפעמים.
sentences.en: He said: a dead man also answers sometimes.
